We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have requested validation of the alleged debt. We understand that you have not received any documentation from Radius Global Solutions, the current creditor of this account.

We confirm that the original creditor of this account is TruConnect Services. The current balance of the account is $8,954.04. The account was charged off on November 6, 2022. We have no record of any payments being made on this account.

In accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We will investigate your dispute and provide you with the necessary documentation. Please allow us 30 days to complete this process.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe the documentation provided is inaccurate or incomplete. Please note that you may request a written validation of the debt, which will include the name of the creditor, an itemization of the charges, and a statement that the debt will be assumed to be valid unless you dispute it within 30 days.

We will send the requested documentation to you via mail. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
